Ake sibheke ulwazi iphunga elilodwa ngesikhathi bese sicabanga ukuthi isitatimende sikaSeoyun silungile kangakanani. Amaswidi awakwazi ukuhlukaniswa noma enziwe ngaphandle kwalutho, futhi awukwazi ukudla ngaphezu kwalokho onakho.

z-m-01-01.title: Izindlela zokwabelana ngamatshe okudlala angu-9 phakathi kwezikhwama ezimbili
z-m-01-01.topic: Ukuhlukanisa nokuhlanganisa izinombolo kuze kube ngu-10
z-m-01-01.goal: Khombisa ngokuzenzela ukuthi kunezindlela eziningi zokuhlukanisa u-9 ube yizinombolo ezimbili, bese uchaza indlela yokuzibala ngaphandle kokushiya.
z-m-01-01.material: Kunamatshe okudlala angu-9. Ufuna ukuwafaka wonke ezikhwameni ezimbili, isikhwama esibomvu nesikhwama esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngaphandle kokushiya noma yiliphi. Isikhwama ngasinye sithola okungenani itshe elingu-1. Izikhwama ezimbili zinemibala ehlukile, ngakho ungazihlukanisa. UMina wathi, 'Kunendlela eyodwa kuphela yokuhlukanisa amatshe angu-9 phakathi kwezikhwama ezimbili.'
z-m-01-01.thinking.2: Ukuchaza indlela yokubala ngaphandle kokushiya noma ukuphinda

z-m-01-01.s.s2.prompt: Hlukanisa wonke amatshe angu-9 ukuze isikhwama esibomvu sibe namatshe amaningi kunesikhwama esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Yenza izindlela ezingu-3 ezihlukile. Isikhwama ngasinye sithola okungenani itshe elingu-1.

z-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Amatshe ezikhwameni ezimbili kumele engeze ku-9.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Isikhwama esibomvu kumele sibe namatshe amaningi kunesikhwama esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.explain: Ukufaka amatshe angu-5, 6, 7, noma 8 esikhwameni esibomvu, zonke izindlela ezingu-4 ziyenzeka. Uma inani esikhwameni esibomvu selisethiwe, inani esikhwameni esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nalo liyasethwa, ngakho inani elihlukile esikhwameni esibomvu lisho indlela ehlukile.
z-m-01-01.s.s3.prompt: Uma uhlukanisa izikhwama ngombala, zingaki izindlela zonke zokuhlukanisa amatshe angu-9 phakathi kwezikhwama ezimbili? Bhala nokuthi ubale kanjani ngaphandle kokushiya noma ukuphinda.

z-m-01-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uhlole ukuthi awuzange ubale indlela efanayo kabili noma ushiye ethile?

z-m-01-01.s.s3.model.0: Ngifake amatshe angu-1, 2, 3, ... 8 esikhwameni esibomvu ngokulandelana futhi ngabhala lokho okusele esikhwameni esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Kungu-1+8, 2+7, ... 8+1, ngakho kunezindlela ezingu-8 ngokuphelele. Uma imibala ihlukile, u-5+4 no-4+5 izindlela ezihlukile.

z-m-01-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izindaba ezifanela umusho wezinombolo 12-5. (12-5 ifundwa 'twelve minus five'.)
z-m-01-06.s.s1.hint.0: Endabeni ngayinye, bhala ukuthi u-12 no-5 ngamunye usho ini.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi lokho indaba ngayinye ifuna ukukuthola 'yinombolo enkulu kuno-12' noma 'yinombolo encane kuno-12'.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.a: Ingane yayinamapenseli angu-12 futhi yathenga amanye angu-5 esitolo sezinto zokubhala. Kunamapenseli amangaki sonke?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kuxhumanise indaba ekhula nomusho wezinombolo 12-5. Bhala futhi umusho wezinombolo ofanela indaba.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.b: Okungu-5 kwamabhaluni angu-12 kuqhume. Mangaki amabhaluni asele?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kuxhumanise indaba lapho okungu-5 kususwa ku-12 nomusho wezinombolo.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.c: Ngemva kokudla ama-apula angu-5, kwasala angu-7 esitsheni. Kwakunama-apula amangaki ekuqaleni?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.c: Umusho wezinombolo akuyona 12-5 kodwa '□-5=7'. Indaba ebuza inombolo yokuqala ikhonjiswa ngomusho wezinombolo ohlukile.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.d: Kunamabhola abomvu angu-12 namabhola aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka angu-5. Mangaki amabhola abomvu angaphezulu?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.d: Ufunde ukuthi indaba eqhathanisa izinombolo ezimbili ukuthola umehluko nayo ingakhonjiswa ngo-12-5.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.explain: Indaba yamabhaluni ibuza inombolo esele ngemva kokuba ama-5 ahambe ku-12, futhi indaba yamabhola ibuza umehluko phakathi kuka-12 no-5. Zombili zingakhonjiswa ngo-12-5. Indaba yamapenseli ingu-12+5, futhi indaba yama-apula ingu-□-5=7.
z-m-01-06.s.s2.prompt: Qamba wena indaba efanela umusho wezinombolo 9+6. Yibhale ukuze ikhombise ukuthi u-9 no-6 bayini endabeni nokuthi ibuza ini. ('9+6' ifundwa 'nine plus six'.)
z-m-01-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuthi u-9 no-6 ngamunye ubala ini.
z-m-01-06.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga isimo esisodwa lapho izinombolo ezimbili zibekwa ndawonye, bese ubhala into ofuna ukuyibuza kuleso simo njengombuzo owodwa.
z-m-01-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe kucacile ukuthi u-9 no-6 bayini endabeni yami?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe impendulo yombuzo yinombolo oyithola nge-9+6?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe iyindaba eyenza umngane acabange nge-9+6 uma ayifunda?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.model.0: Kwakunama-apula angu-9 enkomishini futhi uMama wafaka amanye angu-6. Kunama-apula amangaki sonke?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.model.1: Kwakunezingane eziyisi-9 egcekeni futhi ezingu-6 ezengeziwe zafika. Zingaki izingane egcekeni manje?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.modelNote.1: Impendulo eguqula isimo sokubeka ndawonye saba yindaba lapho izinto zikhula. Indaba ebeka ndawonye amaqembu amabili ahlukile nayo ilungile.

z-m-01-08.title: Inombolo engena ku-□: singayethemba kanjani?
z-m-01-08.goal: Funda ukuthi amanani ka-□ atholwe ngezindlela ezihlukile angahlolwa ngesilinganiso esisodwa, ngokufaka inombolo oyitholile, bese uthola isixazululo esixazululwe ngokungalungile bese utshela umngani indlela yokuhlola.
z-m-01-08.material: Emshweni wenombolo □+6=14, □ 'iyinombolo eyenza u-14 uma wengeza u-6'. U-Dohyeon uyithole ngokuzama izinombolo ku-□ eyodwa ngesikhathi, futhi u-Sea uyithole ngokubala emuva izinyathelo ezingu-6 kusuka ku-14. U-Gaon uxazulule ngenye indlela. ('□+6=14' ifundwa 'ibhokisi kuhlanganiswe eziyisithupha kungu-14'.)
z-m-01-08.prereq.0: Isipiliyoni sokuthola izamba zezinombolo kuze kufike ku-20 nokuthola inombolo eyenza inombolo ethile uma yengezwa
z-m-01-08.s.s1.prompt: Ku-□+6=14, u-Dohyeon uzame u-7, 9, no-8 ku-□ ngokulandelana futhi wathola u-8. U-Sea ubale emuva izinyathelo ezingu-6 kusuka ku-14 futhi wathola u-8. Yini elungile ngezindlela ezimbili?
z-m-01-08.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi izinombolo laba ababili abazitholile ziyafana yini.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.hint.1: Faka inombolo oyitholile, u-8, ku-□, bala u-8+6, bese ubona ukuthi yenza u-14 yini.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.o.a: Ngendlela ka-Dohyeon kuphela yokuzama izinombolo ngqo okungethenjwa
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.a: Lo mcabango wethemba kuphela indlela yokuzama izinombolo ngqo. Indlela ka-Sea nayo inikeze inombolo efanayo, futhi ungahlola ngokuyifaka.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.o.b: Ngendlela ka-Sea kuphela yokubala emuva elungile
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.b: Lo mcabango wamukela kuphela indlela yokubala emuva. Indlela ka-Dohyeon nayo ihloliwe ngokufaka ku-□.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.c: Lesi sinqumo sibona ukuthi zombili izindlela zingahlolwa ngesilinganiso esifanayo (ukuthi ukuyifaka ku-□ kwenza u-14 yini).
z-m-01-08.s.s1.o.d: Indlela ka-Sea, ethole ngokushesha, iyindlela elungile.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.d: Ukuthola ngokushesha akunaluhlobo nokulunga. Isilinganiso ukuthi inombolo oyitholile yenza u-14 yini uma ifakwe ku-□.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.explain: Ukuzama izinombolo nokubala emuva kuyizindlela ezihlukile, kodwa zithole inombolo efanayo, u-8. Noma yiyiphi indlela osebenzisa, ungayethemba inombolo uma uyifaka ku-□ futhi uhlola ukuthi 8+6=14.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.prompt: U-Gaon uthole u-□ ku-□+6=14 kanje. Khetha umugqa owodwa onzima ukuwukholelwa.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ulinganisele ukuthi u-□ kungenzeka ube yinombolo enkulu kuno-14 noma encane kuno-14.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.hint.1: Funda umugqa ngamunye wesixazululo ngokulandelana bese uqhathanisa nalokho okulinganiselwe ngaphambilini.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.line.0: Uma wengeza u-6 ku-□ uthola u-14, usho.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.line.1: Ngakho ufaka u-14 no-6 ndawonye ukuthola u-□.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.explain: Umugqa 2 yinkinga yokuqala. Uma ukwengeza u-6 ku-□ kwenza u-14, khona ukwengeza u-6 omunye ku-14 kunikeza inombolo enkulu kuno-□. Ngakho □=20 emugqeni 4 nakho kunzima ukukukholelwa. Lokho obona kuncike emugqeni owukhethayo. Umugqa 1 ulungile ngoba uguqule umusho wenombolo waba ngamagama.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.prompt: Bhala, njengamagama atshela u-Gaon, indlela u-Gaon angahlola ngayo yena ukuthi □=20 ilungile yini.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.hint.0: Faka u-20 u-Gaon alithole endaweni ka-□ bese ubala uhlangothi lwesobunxele.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.hint.1: Beka umphumela wokubala kwakho eceleni kuka-14 ohlangothini lwesokudla, uqhathanise ukuthi ufana yini, bese utshela u-Gaon.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ngokulandelana ukuze u-Gaon alandele?
z-m-01-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi yikuphi ukubala okwenzayo uma ufaka u-20?
z-m-01-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usho ukuthi umphumela uyafana noma uyahluka ku-14?
z-m-01-08.s.s3.model.0: Faka u-20 endaweni ka-□ bese ubala 20+6. Ingu-26, ngakho akuyona u-14. Ngakho u-20 uphutha.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.model.1: Masifake u-20. 20+6=26, okuhluke ku-14, ngakho kuphutha. Uma ufaka enye inombolo, u-8, khona 8+6=14, ngakho kulungile.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.modelNote.1: Impendulo ehlola inombolo engalungile bese iphinda izame nenombolo elungile.

z-m-01-04.title: '=' ihlala isho ukubhala impendulo?
z-m-01-04.goal: Thola esixazululweni esisebenzile ukungaqondi okungalungile kokuthi '=' uphawu lokubhala impendulo kuphela, bese uhlulela ukuthi imisho yezinombolo iyiqiniso noma iphutha ngencazelo yokuthi izinhlangothi zombili zinenani elifanayo.
z-m-01-04.material: UJiho uxazulule inkinga yokuthola inombolo ehamba ku-□ ku-3+4=□+2. Bheka isixazululo sikaJiho umugqa ngomugqa bese ucabanga ukuthi '=' ikhombisani. ('3+4' ifundwa 'three plus four', futhi '□' ifundwa 'box'.)
z-m-01-04.prereq.0: Isipiliyoni sokubala okulula ngezinombolo kuze kube ngu-10
z-m-01-04.s.s1.prompt: UJiho uxazulule inombolo ku-□ ku-3+4=□+2 kanje. Khetha umugqa owodwa onzima ukuwukholwa.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.hint.0: Funda umugqa ngamunye ngokuzwakalayo ubone ukuthi ulandela ngokwemvelo yini emugqeni osandulela.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.hint.1: Emshweni wezinombolo emugqeni 3, bala uhlangothi lwesobunxele 3+4 nolwesokudla 7+2 ngokwehlukana bese uziqhathanisa.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.line.1: Ngemva kwe-= ubhala umphumela wokubala, ngakho bhala u-7 ku-□.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 yinkinga yokuqala. '=' ayihlali isho ukuthi umphumela uza ngemva kwayo; isho ukuthi uhlangothi lwesobunxele nolwesokudla zinenani elifanayo. Uma ubala umusho wezinombolo emugqeni 3, uhlangothi lwesobunxele lungu-7 futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla 7+2 lungu-9, ngakho aluyafani. Ngakho nesiphetho emugqeni 4 sinzima ukusikholwa. Okubonayo kuncike emugqeni owukhethayo. Umugqa 1 ubalwe kahle.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.prompt: '=' isho ini? Khetha impendulo engcono kakhulu.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.hint.0: Funda 3+4=7 no-7=3+4 ngamunye ngokuzwakalayo ubone ukuthi bobabili banengqondo yini.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.hint.1: Uma kunezinto ezingu-3+4 ohlangothini olulodwa lwesikali futhi ezingu-□+2 kolunye futhi silinganisiwe, sho ukuthi lobo budlelwano buyini.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.a: Lo mcabango ubona '=' njengendawo yokubhala impendulo kuphela. Kunzima ukuchaza imisho yezinombolo ebhalwe njengo-7=3+4.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.b: Lo mcabango ubona '=' njengomyalo wokubala. Awubonanga ukuthi iyisignali sokuqhathanisa ukuthi izinhlangothi zombili zinenani elifanayo yini.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.c: Lo mcabango uyibona njengesignali sokuthi izinhlangothi zombili zinenani elifanayo.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.d: Lo mcabango awukwazi ukwehlukanisa 'okufanayo' no-'okukhulu'. 'Okukhulu' kukhonjiswa ngophawu oluhlukile.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.explain: '=' isho ukuthi izinhlangothi zombili zinenani elifanayo. Ngakho ku-3+4=□+2, udinga ukwenza □+2 ibe nenani elifanayo no-3+4.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.prompt: Khetha yonke imisho yezinombolo eyiqiniso engezansi.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bala uhlangothi lwesobunxele nolwesokudla lomusho wezinombolo ngamunye ngokwehlukana bese ubhala phansi.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.hint.1: Uma izinhlangothi ezimbili ziyafana, kungumusho wezinombolo oyiqiniso. Uma zingafani, sho ukuthi uhlangothi luni olukhulu.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.a: Noma ukubala kusohlangothini lwesokudla lwe-'=', incazelo ethi 'okufanayo' ayishintshi.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.b: Isobunxele singu-7 futhi esokudla singu-8, ngakho aziyafani. Lokhu akuhlolanga ukuthi '=' isho inani elifanayo.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.c: Izinhlangothi zombili zingu-7. Noma kunokubala ezinhlangothini zombili, ungaqhathanisa ukuthi ziyafana yini.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.d: Lokhu kungase kube yimbono ebheke kuphela ukuthi inombolo yesobunxele yanda ngo-malini ekubaleni kwesokudla futhi yanquma ukuthi ziyafana. Kufanele ubale izinhlangothi zombili ngokwehlukana bese uziqhathanisa.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.explain: 7=3+4 iyiqiniso ngoba izinhlangothi zombili zingu-7, futhi 6+1=5+2 iyiqiniso ngoba izinhlangothi zombili zingu-7. 3+4=7+1 ingu-7 no-8, futhi 3+4=4+4 ingu-7 no-8, ngakho aziyiqiniso.

z-m-01-05.title: Iseduze no-40 noma no-50?
z-m-01-05.topic: Ukuthola ishumi eliseduze ezinombolweni kuze kube ngu-100
z-m-01-05.goal: Qhathanisa ukusondela ngenani lamagxathu emugqeni wezinombolo, funda ngamacala lapho ungakwazi ukusho ukuthi yiliphi eliseduze, bese wenza wena izinombolo ezifanela imibandela.
z-m-01-05.material: Cabanga u-40, 41, 42, ..., 60 behlelwe igxathu elilodwa komunye nomunye emugqeni wezinombolo. Siqhathanisa ukuthi izinombolo ezimbili ziseduze kangakanani ngenani lamagxathu aziqhelelene ngawo emugqeni wezinombolo. Lapho kunamagxathu ambalwa, kuseduze kakhulu. Kulesi sikhathi, cabanga kuphela ngezinombolo zemvelo.
z-m-01-05.prereq.0: Ukulandelana nokuqhathanisa osayizi bezinombolo kuze kube ngu-100 (izinga lebanga 1)
z-m-01-05.s.s1.prompt: Emugqeni wezinombolo, u-40, 41, 42, ..., 50 behlelwe igxathu elilodwa komunye nomunye. U-47 useduze no-40 noma no-50?
z-m-01-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bala ukuthi mangaki amagxathu kusukela ku-47 uye kwesokudla ku-50.
z-m-01-05.s.s1.hint.1: Bala nokuthi mangaki amagxathu kusukela ku-47 uye kwesobunxele ku-40, bese uqhathanisa.
z-m-01-05.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sinqumo sibale futhi saqhathanisa amagxathu kusukela ku-47 ohlangothini ngalunye.
z-m-01-05.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kungase kube umbono wokuthi ishumi eliza kuqala lisondele kakhulu. Akubalanga ukuthi u-47 ukude ngamagxathu amangaki nalinye ngalinye.
z-m-01-05.s.s1.r.c: Lo mcabango awuqhathanisanga inani lamagxathu aya ezindaweni ezimbili futhi wacabanga nje ukuthi uphakathi.
z-m-01-05.s.s1.explain: Kusuka ku-47 kuya ku-50 kungamagxathu ama-3, futhi kuya ku-40 kungamagxathu ayisi-7. Uhlangothi olunamagxathu ambalwa luseduze kakhulu.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bala amagxathu kusukela ku-45 uye kwesobunxele ku-40 nokuya kwesokudla ku-50, ngalinye ngokwehlukana.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala izinombolo ezimbili zamagxathu eceleni komunye nomunye bese uqhathanisa ukuthi yiyiphi enkulu.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.o.a: Useduze no-50, ngoba savumelana ngokuzungeza phezulu uma kunowu-5
z-m-01-05.s.s2.r.a: Isivumelwano sihluke ekusondeleni. Asisona isizathu esisekelwe ekubaleni nasekuqhathaniseni amagxathu.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.o.b: Ungamagxathu ama-5 ukusuka ku-40 namagxathu ama-5 ukusuka ku-50, ngakho akukho uhlangothi oluseduze
z-m-01-05.s.s2.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sibale amagxathu ezindaweni ezimbili sawaqhathanisa.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.o.c: Useduze no-40, ngoba u-4 uza ngaphambi kuka-5
z-m-01-05.s.s2.r.c: Lo mcabango unqume ngokuthi yiyiphi inombolo eza kuqala noma kamuva kuphela. Awubalanga ukuthi u-45 ukude ngamagxathu amangaki nohlangothi ngalunye.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.explain: Kusuka ku-45 kuya ku-40 kungamagxathu ama-5, futhi kuya ku-50 nakho kungamagxathu ama-5, ngakho awukwazi ukunquma ukuthi yimuphi oseduze. Ecaleni elinjena, sidinga isivumelwano sokuthi sibuthumela kuphi.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.acc.0: Uma ulandela isivumelwano 'zungeza phezulu uma kunowu-5', ungasho u-50. Kodwa lokho kuyisivumelwano esasenza, hhayi ngoba u-45 useduze no-50. Kungcono nakakhulu ukusho kuqala ukuthi useduze nawo womabili ngokulinganayo.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.prompt: Bhala izinombolo ezi-3 ezahlukile ezinkulu kuno-40 futhi ezincane kuno-60 futhi ezisondele ku-50 kunokuba zisondele ku-40 noma ku-60.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha ongenela oyedwa ngokuqhathanisa ukuthi ukude ngamagxathu amangaki no-50 nokuthi ukude ngamangaki no-40 no-60.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.hint.1: Thola ukuthi ongenela wakho unenani elifanayo lamagxathu no-40 noma no-60 liphi, bese ushiya leyo nombolo.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.ok.c1: Iyinombolo enkulu kuno-40 futhi encane kuno-60.

z-m-01-05.s.s3.fail.c2: Iseduze no-40 kunokuba iseduze no-50, noma iseduze nawo womabili ngokulinganayo.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.fail.c3: Iseduze no-60 kunokuba iseduze no-50, noma iseduze nawo womabili ngokulinganayo.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.explain: Zonke izinombolo kusukela ku-46 kuya ku-54 ziyafanela imibandela. U-45 no-55 baseduze ngokulinganayo nelinye lamashumi, ngakho abafaneli umbandela othi 'iseduze'.
